jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp902_box.1: SCP-902, The Final Countdown, is an old olive-drab steel ammunition box. It ticks softly and steadily, sixty times a minute, whether it is carried or set down.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp902_box.2: Use it to lift or close the lid, in the hand or placed. It is always empty. Nothing can be put into it, and nothing has ever come out of it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp902_box.3: It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-902 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal. A stranger in Foundation dress will bring the box to you by hand.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp902_props.1: Worn trench fittings: duckboards, sandbags, revetments, wire and crates. Made at the Decoration Workbench.

dossier.scp_unleashed.902.title: The Final Countdown
dossier.scp_unleashed.902.caption: SCP-902 at intake with its lid raised, beside a scale rule. Nothing was found inside.
dossier.scp_unleashed.902.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
dossier.scp_unleashed.902.page.0.text.0: SCP-902 is kept closed in a padded steel locker in an unlit room at the end of a disused corridor. The room is to remain locked and unattended outside scheduled observation.
dossier.scp_unleashed.902.page.0.text.1: Personnel assigned to SCP-902 are rotated every fourteen days. **Personnel are not to remain with SCP-902 for longer than their shift requires.**
dossier.scp_unleashed.902.page.0.text.2: Any member of staff found in the room outside their shift is to be escorted out and offered rest. %rThey usually say they were only listening.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.902.page.1.title: Description:
dossier.scp_unleashed.902.page.1.text.0: SCP-902 is a steel ammunition box of a mid-century military pattern, roughly thirty centimetres long, painted olive drab and stencilled CAL .30 above a lot number that matches no known record. The paint is chipped and the edges are rusted through in places. A wire carry handle lies folded on the lid, and a latch on one end holds the lid shut.
dossier.scp_unleashed.902.page.1.text.1: SCP-902 produces a soft, steady ticking at sixty beats to the minute, whether it is closed, open, carried or set down. The rate has never varied. Listeners describe the sound as patient.
dossier.scp_unleashed.902.page.1.text.2: When opened, SCP-902 is empty. Its interior is bare steel, flecked with rust. Nothing can be placed inside it, and nothing has ever been found in it. This is all perfectly normal.
dossier.scp_unleashed.902.page.1.text.3: Those who have spent long periods close to SCP-902 sometimes describe a vivid episode: rain, a trench, distant gunfire, and a low sun at the far end of a field of mud. %rWitnesses report that the subject remained standing exactly where they had been, silent and immovable, until the episode ended.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.902.page.2.title: Addendum 902-1: Interview
dossier.scp_unleashed.902.page.2.text.1: "I'd got down close to it, to hear it better. Then it was raining. Proper rain, the kind that gets into everything. The box was there in the mud, the same box. Somebody was firing a long way off. And the sun was sitting right at the end of it all, huge, like it was waiting."
dossier.scp_unleashed.902.page.2.text.2: "Then there were words, just hanging there. It is not yet time. And I was back."
dossier.scp_unleashed.902.page.2.text.3: Asked whether she wished to return, Agent %rOkafor%r said no. Then she said she was not sure.
dossier.scp_unleashed.902.page.3.title: Addendum 902-2: Test Log
dossier.scp_unleashed.902.page.3.text.0: Test 902-04: the lid was opened and closed two hundred times in one sitting. The box was empty every time. The ticking did not change.
dossier.scp_unleashed.902.page.3.text.1: Test 902-06: a stopwatch was set beside SCP-902 for one week. The two agreed to the second. %rThe stopwatch was found stopped on the eighth day. SCP-902 had not.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.902.page.3.text.2: Test 902-09: D-4471 was asked to sit with SCP-902 and describe what he heard. He said, "It's counting." Asked what it was counting toward, he said it wasn't his turn yet.
dossier.scp_unleashed.902.page.4.title: Addendum 902-3: Provenance
dossier.scp_unleashed.902.page.4.text: SCP-902 has no recovery record. It was delivered to a reader of this file. See field notes.
